claims.claim: Roper's Q2 2026 revenue increased 9% to $2.11B with 5% organic growth; application software revenue grew 7.8%, network software 11.8%, and technology-enabled products 7.3%.

factors.name: portfolio breadth
factors.basis: Primary filing shows growth across all three operating segments.

factors.name: acquisition contribution
factors.basis: Acquisitions add growth but complicate organic quality and capital-allocation assessment.

risks.risk: Network Software operating margin fell to 41.0% from 43.9%, partly reflecting acquired-business profiles.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 operating cash flow rose 16% to $469M and adjusted free cash flow rose 11% to $447M; Roper also repurchased $1.2B of shares in the quarter and increased full-year guidance.

factors.name: cash execution
factors.basis: Cash-flow growth provides execution evidence beyond accounting earnings.

factors.name: capital deployment
factors.basis: Large repurchases can add per-share value but compete with acquisition capacity and require valuation context outside Scout authority.

risks.risk: Interest expense increased because of higher average debt and rates, a counterweight to portfolio cash generation.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not judge repurchase attractiveness without canonical valuation inputs.
